build_enterprise_router: build a FastAPI router that includes email events, audit logging, and management sub-routers
create_robots_txt_endpoint: create a GET endpoint that returns robots.txt to block web crawlers from indexing proxy endpoints
configure_block_robots: configure the block_robots setting in general_settings to control crawler access to the proxy server
include_audit_logging_router: include the audit_logging_router to expose GET /audit and GET /audit/{id} endpoints for audit log CRUD
include_management_endpoints_router: include the management_endpoints_router to expose internal user and project management endpoints
